symptom_short: A restarted ZooKeeper observer never syncs with the leader: every sync attempt dies with a NullPointerException while it is rolling its transaction log back, the member loops forever re-electing and retrying, and each attempt leaks its leader connection (sockets pile up in CLOSE_WAIT until connections fail)

milestones.note: Folder scaffolded (private/ source/ logs/ diagnosis/); PROGRESS.md + state.json created; bug claimed in COORDINATION.log.

JIRA ZOOKEEPER-1900 'NullPointerException in truncate' (Blocker, affects 3.4.5/3.4.6, fixVersion 3.4.7+3.5.0, Resolved/Fixed; reported by Camille Fournier). Ticket quotes the stack frame 'java.lang.NullPointerException at org.apache.zookeeper.server.persistence.FileTxnLog.truncate(FileTxnLog.java:352)' and the message 'Truncating log to get in sync with the leader', repeated >1M times/day, plus ~29k sockets stuck in CLOSE_WAIT until new connections failed with ConnectException. Fix commit (trunk/3.5.0) = 6abd85938 (Alexander Shraer, 2014-06-30, svn trunk@1606841); companion branch-3.4 commit 8ff14a712 saved as private/fix.branch-3.4.diff. Trunk diff changes exactly two production lines: (1) FileTxnLog.truncate() gains 'if (input == null) throw new IOException("No log files found to truncate! ...")' before 'long pos = input.getPosition();' and (2) Observer.observeLeader()'s inner 'catch (IOException e)' becomes 'catch (Exception e)'; it also adds TruncateTest.testTruncationNullLog. The branch-3.4 diff is identical plus the same catch widening in Follower.java (trunk's Follower already caught Exception). pre_fix_commit = 8cfb9a0ef (ZOOKEEPER-1576, 2014-06-27) - verified its FileTxnLog.truncate does 'PositionInputStream input = itr.inputStream; long pos = input.getPosition();' with no null guard, and FileTxnIterator.init() leaves inputStream null when the log directory contains no log.* file (storedFiles stays empty so goToNextLog() returns false). Confirmed the diff resolves the reported symptom: a learner told to TRUNC whose dataLogDir holds no txn log NPEs inside truncate; on an observer the NPE (a RuntimeException) escapes the 'catch (IOException)' in observeLeader, so sock.close() never runs (CLOSE_WAIT leak) and the exception unwinds to QuorumPeer.run, which drops the peer back to LOOKING and retries forever.

Built the pre-fix tree (8cfb9a0ef, ZooKeeper 3.5.0-SNAPSHOT) from source with Ant+Ivy in per-bug image clods-eval:Zookeeper-Zookeeper-1900 (clods-eval base + openjdk-8-jdk + ant + ant-optional; JDK 11/17 refuse -source/-target < 7). Build cmd: 'ant jar' -> build/zookeeper-3.5.0-SNAPSHOT.jar + build/classes + build/lib (slf4j 1.7.5, log4j 1.2.16, jline 2.11, netty 3.7.0.Final, commons-cli 1.2). Dep fixes (private/deps-fix.patch, 3 edits, no source changes; identical to the ones another agent needed for the neighbouring 2014 trunk commit): (1) build.xml ivy.url http://repo2.maven.org -> https://repo1.maven.org (repo2 host is gone and Central refuses plain HTTP); (2) build.xml javac.source/javac.target 1.5 -> 1.8 (javac 8 rejects source/target 1.5 with its 1.8 bootclasspath); (3) ivysettings.xml repo.maven.org/repo.jboss.org/repo.sun.org -> https://repo1.maven.org (jboss nexus + download.java.net are dead). BUILD SUCCESSFUL in 7s, 4 rawtypes warnings only.

Reproduced on the real system: a 4-member ZooKeeper 3.5.0-SNAPSHOT ensemble built from the pre-fix tree (myid 1-3 participants, myid 4 peerType=observer), all four with root logger AND console appender at DEBUG, snapshots (dataDir) and transaction logs (dataLogDir) on separate directories, roles discovered with the servers' own 'srvr' 4lw. PHASE A (previous deployment): six concurrent Workload clients x 280 create/getData/setData/exists/getChildren/delete iterations spread over all three participants, a real zkCli shell session on the leader (40x create/get/set/stat + 20 deletes) and a client doing ephemeral work through the observer -> ~4000 txns; the observer ends with 18 snapshots + 18 txn logs, newest snapshot.100000fc6. All members stopped. PHASE B (operator action, no code touched): the three participants are re-provisioned on empty storage; the observer keeps its dataDir and its dataLogDir is repointed at a new EMPTY directory - the exact situation the upstream fix's own message names ('snapshots from an old setup ... or dataLogDir was changed in zoo.cfg'). PHASE C (incident): the re-provisioned quorum comes up at epoch 1 (leader zxid 0x1000003b0) and serves real traffic (2x120-iteration workloads + a client doing 185 ops over the 40s window, 0 failures). The observer starts, reports its snapshot zxid 0x100000fc6 (far ahead), the leader logs 'Synchronizing with Follower sid: 4 maxCommittedLog=0x100000269 ... peerLastZxid=0x100000fc6' and 'Sending TRUNC to follower', and the observer dies with java.lang.NullPointerException at FileTxnLog.truncate:381 <- FileTxnSnapLog.truncateLog:317 <- ZKDatabase.truncateLog:504 <- Learner.syncWithLeader:348 <- Observer.observeLeader:79 <- QuorumPeer.run:961, then 'shutdown called' -> PeerState LOOKING -> OBSERVING -> same failure, 6239 times in 40s. It never serves a client (srvr: 'This ZooKeeper instance is not currently serving requests'; an ordinary client gets connect=TIMEOUT after 20s in CONNECTING) and it leaks one leader connection per attempt (observer sockets 25 -> 122, CLOSE_WAIT 0 -> 42). Detection is silent: assertions read the servers' own logs, the clients' result files and /proc, and print only to reproduce.sh stdout. Workload.java writes nothing to stdout/stderr; NO log or print statement was added to ZooKeeper anywhere. private/symptom.orig.log = 524674 lines / 75 MB (241073 DEBUG, 119743 INFO, 31333 WARN/ERROR) = 8 server logs (previous deployment + current) + 13 client session logs, one '===== file: X =====' header each. Attempt 1 (identical scenario, 2 clients x 700 ops, 70s window) also reproduced (11276 NPEs); it was re-run only to keep each client's request xid below 1900 and to halve the log size.

Minimal, case-targeted anonymization. The two ticket-quoted log messages were rewritten at the source, so the binaries emit 'Rolling back the transaction log to get in sync with the leader' and the stack frame reads FileTxnLog.rollBack(FileTxnLog.java:381) - same line, renamed method (the ticket's :352 is the 3.4.5 line). Everything else stays real: packages, all other class names, leader/follower/observer/learner/quorum/znode/zxid/epoch/snapshot terminology, every other log message, the NullPointerException type and full stack shape, version 3.5.0-SNAPSHOT. The renamed tree was REBUILT ('ant jar', BUILD SUCCESSFUL) at the NEUTRAL path repos/zookeeper-ensemble-src (the JVM prints user.dir + the classpath into every log, so a path naming the bug leaked '1900' 40+ times in the M3 log) and reproduce.sh was re-run against it, so logs/symptom.log (512839 lines / 74 MB) is the genuine output of the renamed binaries, not a rewritten log: the failure reproduces identically (6058 NPEs in 40s at FileTxnLog.rollBack:381, observer snapshot 0x100001013 vs leader 0x1000003b2, srvr 'not currently serving requests', client connect=TIMEOUT, observer sockets 35->113, CLOSE_WAIT 0->32). source/ = the full renamed pre-fix Java tree (282 files: src/java/main + src/java/generated), not a hand-curated subset, so no file-selection hint is given to the LLM. symptom.md = 13-line operator-level description: a 4-member 3.5.0 ensemble was rebuilt (three participants re-provisioned on empty storage, the observer left alone except that its transaction-log directory now points at a replacement volume); since the restart the quorum is healthy and serves clients, but the observer never rejoins - every attempt to join the leader ends in an unhandled exception, it falls back to leader election and retries many times a second indefinitely, it reports that it is not serving requests, a client pointed at it never gets a session, and its open sockets keep growing (~1 per attempt) into CLOSE_WAIT. No bug id, no fix hint, no internal mechanism: following the 1851 precedent the exception type and the stack frames are NOT named in symptom.md - they are left for the LLM to find in the log. ground_truth.md derived from private/fix.diff: the trunk fix changes exactly two production lines, both on the reproduced path. REQUIRED SITE A = FileTxnLog.rollBack (upstream truncate) lines 380-381: 'PositionInputStream input = itr.inputStream; long pos = input.getPosition();' is dereferenced with no null guard (the fix inserts 'if (input == null) throw new IOException(...)'); the exact condition is that FileTxnIterator.init() (566-582) finds no log.* file in the configured txnlog dir, so storedFiles stays empty, goToNextLog() (601-608) returns false without calling createInputArchive() (633-639), the only assignment of inputStream. REQUIRED SITE B = Observer.observeLeader line 85 'catch (IOException e)': the NPE is a RuntimeException so the handler does not apply - sock.close() (88) and pendingRevalidations.clear() (94) never run (one leaked leader connection per attempt, CLOSE_WAIT; Learner.shutdown() does not close sock either) and the exception unwinds to QuorumPeer.run's case OBSERVING catch(Exception)/finally updateServerState() (957-969) -> LOOKING -> re-elect -> OBSERVING -> same failure forever. The fix widens it to catch (Exception e). Credit-neutral supporting context (not required): LearnerHandler.syncFollower's 'peerLastZxid > maxCommittedLog && !isPeerNewEpochZxid' -> queueOpPacket(Leader.ROLLBACK, maxCommittedLog) (708-714), Learner.syncWithLeader's ROLLBACK branch (344-348), and ZKDatabase.clear() setting initialized=false so the next attempt reloads the same old snapshot zxid. PASS requires BOTH A (line + the null-ness condition) and B; naming Follower.followLeader instead of Observer does not satisfy B (trunk's Follower already catches Exception). Grading rule fixed before any run was read. Leakage re-verified across source/ + logs/symptom.log + symptom.md: 0 hits for ZOOKEEPER-1900, bare 1900, [Tt]runcat and TRUNC.
